notes:
Need to search first.I wasn't able to research Song of Solomon 2, so I have no verse-by-verse notes to give you.

My first attempt to open the commentary pages failed because the tool only opens pages that a search has already returned. When I then ran a batch of 12 searches, that one call went over the tool-use limit, and after that I had no research calls left for this turn. I didn't read any page from the approved sites. Your rules say to use only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point, so I haven't written anything from memory.

**Next steps:** If you ask again in a new message, I'll run fewer searches at a time and then open the pages, in this order:
1. **Verse-by-verse sources:** Enduring Word (Song of Solomon 2), and Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub.com or studylight.org, plus preceptaustin.org.
2. **Topic searches:** "rose of Sharon" (v. 1), "his banner over me is love" (v. 4), "do not arouse or awaken love" (v. 7), the dove "in the clefts of the rock" (v. 14) and "the little foxes" (v. 15). These should bring up pages from gotquestions.org, desiringgod.org, ligonier.org, thegospelcoalition.org and similar.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes; Catholic and Orthodox readings on newadvent.org, catholic.com and oca.org; and the debate over reading the book as a picture of Christ and the church or as a poem about married love.

You could also paste the text of specific commentary pages here, and I'll write the notes using only what they say.
